profile_text.body:
Captions is an AI video generator and editor founded in 2021 and headquartered in New York City. The company describes itself as a tool that makes it easy to go from idea to ready-to-share content regardless of a user's editing skillset, positioning its AI as something that understands story and tailors edits to specific footage rather than simply automating cuts at speed.

The company's primary product, Captions AI, falls within the video generation and editing category and covers a range of functions including automatic scene cutting, B-roll overlay, caption generation, translated subtitles, AI voiceovers, and script-to-video workflows. The platform also offers the ability to create an AI twin or use digital avatars, with prompts available to change outfits, backgrounds, or product inserts, and the product notes reference eye contact correction, dubbing, and likeness manipulation consent as features associated with that functionality. Use cases listed on the site include short-form social videos, ads, tutorials, product demos, real estate listing videos, and thought leadership content.

The site's held facts record 311 law exposure entries linked to New York, though no specific cases or litigation details are present in the available data. No MCP server registrations or SEC filings are noted for the company.
